description: The bar chart, titled 'Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks,' compares the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and Ours (Iterative RLHF), across nine datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis, labeled 'Dataset and Metrics,' lists the categories in the order: GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis, labeled 'Score (%),' has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 80, marked at 10% intervals. The chart displays grouped bars for each dataset, with LLaMA-3-8B-it represented in blue and Ours (Iterative RLHF) in orange. The scores for GSM-8K are approximately 79% for both models, while for MMLU, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores around 66% and Ours (Iterative RLHF) scores around 64%. For HumanEval, LLaMA-3-8B-it scores about 61%, and Ours (Iterative RLHF) scores around 63%. TruthfulQA shows LLaMA-3-8B-it at approximately 43% and Ours (Iterative RLHF) at 60%. ARC and MBPP have identical scores for both models, around 60%. LC AlpacaEval-2 has scores of about 20% for LLaMA-3-8B-it and 30% for Ours (Iterative RLHF), while MT-Bench (×5) scores around 40% for LLaMA-3-8B-it and 42% for Ours (Iterative RLHF). Chat-Arena-Hard shows the lowest scores, with LLaMA-3-8B-it at approximately 18% and Ours (Iterative RLHF) at 27%. The bars are grouped by dataset, with no specific sorting order observed, and no bars are visually emphasized.
caption_used: The bar chart titled 'Model Evaluation on Academic and Practical Benchmarks' compares the performance of two models, LLaMA-3-8B-it and Ours (Iterative RLHF), across nine datasets and metrics. The horizontal axis is labeled 'Dataset and Metrics,' with categories including GSM-8K, MMLU, HumanEval, TruthfulQA, ARC, MBPP, LC AlpacaEval-2, MT-Bench (×5), and Chat-Arena-Hard. The vertical axis represents 'Score (%)' on a linear scale from 0 to 80, marked at intervals of 10%. Both models perform similarly on GSM-8K, achieving scores of approximately 80%. On MMLU, LLaMA-3-8B-it slightly outperforms Ours (Iterative RLHF) with a score of 70% compared to 65%. For HumanEval, Ours (Iterative RLHF) shows a notable improvement, scoring 70% compared to LLaMA-3-8B-it's 60%. TruthfulQA demonstrates a consistent upward trend for both models, with Ours (Iterative RLHF) reaching 65% and LLaMA-3-8B-it trailing at 45%. ARC and MBPP show identical performance for both models at 60%. LC AlpacaEval-2 and MT-Bench (×5) exhibit modest scores, with Ours (Iterative RLHF) slightly outperforming LLaMA-3-8B-it. Chat-Arena-Hard shows the lowest scores, with both models performing below 30%. Overall, Ours (Iterative RLHF) consistently outperforms LLaMA-3-8B-it across most benchmarks, particularly in HumanEval and TruthfulQA, demonstrating its superior generalization capabilities.
